callout_id: 无理测度的定义以及基本的命题#7
statement_en: The set of all badly approximable real numbers has Lebesgue measure zero, that is, $$m(\mathbf{Bad})=0.$$
key_techniques: measure estimate via complements of approximation sets
callout_body: 所有Badly approximable的实数，形成的集合是Lebesgue零测度的，即$$m(\mathbf{Bad})=0$$
